note: Guides in the author's own words. Each guide names the published guide its facts draw on; no text is copied from any of them. Trophy names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list, held in app/data/trophies.json.

guides.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks on its own. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers, activities, world cleanup, and 100% completion last — and this is the final trophy you earn.

Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission and teaches driving, shooting and switching between Lucia and Jason. The trophy pops when the mission ends — just play the story.
Complete Chapter 1 by finishing every story mission in the first chapter. Story trophies unlock in chapter order, and any mission can be replayed from the pause menu if you need to.
Complete Chapter 2 by finishing every story mission in the second chapter. Keep following the story markers; the trophy pops at the chapter's final mission.
Complete Chapter 3 by finishing every story mission in the third chapter. Vice City opens up fully in this stretch, so use the time between missions for side activities.
Complete Chapter 4 by finishing every story mission in the fourth chapter. This is the last full chapter before the finale — finish it and only the final mission remains.
Complete the final mission of the story. It unlocks after Chapter 4; finish it and the gold trophy pops. After the finale, free roam continues, so nothing is locked off.
Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears in the story flow — follow the mission marker, finish the mission, and the trophy pops. If you miss it, replay the mission from the pause menu.
Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a heist mission in the story — plan the approach the mission gives you, finish the job, and the trophy pops on completion.
Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow the mission markers through to the end; the trophy unlocks when the mission completes.
Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a story mission — finish it and the trophy pops. Check the mission list in the pause menu if you are unsure where it sits in the story.
Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The mission takes you to Vice City International Airport — finish the takedown and the trophy unlocks.
Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the later story missions — finish it and the trophy pops on completion.

Attain 100% completion: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and world tasks all feed the percentage. Open the 100% checklist in the pause menu to see what is left, work through the roadmap stages in order, and save this for last — it is the final gold before the platinum.

Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total. The fastest farm is a quick bike on the highway: chain near-misses with traffic and jumps off ramps. The pause menu shows your running count.

Try each type of activity once — all 9 activity types (races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation, hunting and challenges). Open the activities menu to see the list, then play one of each.

Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — every weapon range challenge at gold. Pick the recommended loadout for each challenge, aim for headshots, and replay any challenge from the range menu until it turns gold.
Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 race spots in total. Look for the Top Fun van icon on the map, win one race at each of the 14 locations, and the trophy pops after the last one.

Win 20 different races — road, off-road and street races. Each distinct race event counts once, so work through the race list instead of repeating one event; the race menu shows which you have already won.
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Challenge Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him: match the lure to the water, keep the line tension in the green, and reel steadily instead of yanking.
Complete an arcade game — finish one full game at any arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest game on the cabinet, play it through to the end, and the trophy pops when the game completes.
Complete the final mission for Andy — finish Andy's stranger strand. Stranger missions appear as question-mark icons on the map; follow Andy's chain of missions to its last one.
Complete the final mission for Kenton — finish Kenton's stranger strand. Follow his question-mark missions in order until the strand ends.
Complete the final mission for Billy — finish Billy's stranger strand. His missions appear as question-mark icons; complete the chain to its final mission.

Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida — finish eight full stranger storylines. Each strand is a chain of missions from a question-mark contact; the stranger menu shows how many strands you have completed.
Complete the final mission for Randy — finish Randy's stranger strand. Follow his question-mark missions to the last one in the chain.
Complete the final mission for Tyrone — finish Tyrone's stranger strand. His missions appear as question-mark icons; complete the chain to its final mission.

Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots in total. Look for the lotus icon on the map, sit down and complete the session at each of the 18 spots; the meditation menu tracks which you have done.
Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks a rare animal for you — track it with the hunting scope, follow its trail, and take it down cleanly. Bring a scoped rifle and approach from downwind.

Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — find cards across Leonida and finish three full sets. Cards glow in the world and cluster around landmarks; the collection menu shows each set and which cards you still need.
WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the WAiNK camera feature at 100 marked spots. Spots appear on the map once you are near them; frame the shot and snap it at each of the 100 locations.

Complete 50 Challenges — the game's challenge list covers driving, combat and exploration. Open the challenge menu to see your progress and pick the quick ones first; every completed challenge counts toward the 50.
Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: your partner must be with you when the wanted level clears. Bring them along before you raise the heat.

guides.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hold up three shops in a row while the wanted level stays up — plan a route through three nearby shops and keep moving between them.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: the streak breaks if the wanted level drops between shops. Chain the three robberies without a break.

guides.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride 100 different vehicles. Every new model you enter counts, from cars and bikes to boats and aircraft; the vehicle list in the pause menu shows what you have found.

Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus (slow-motion aim) during a busy firefight and drop five enemies before it ends — pick a shootout with plenty of cover and grouped enemies.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: all five takedowns must happen inside one Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded firefight before activating it.

guides.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave Vice City International Airport without a ticket. Steal a plane on the runway and take off, or otherwise get airborne from the airport grounds.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: it is a stunt you have to attempt on purpose — nothing in the story sends you to do it.

guides.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — deal with the Rhino tanks. Raise your wanted level high enough for Rhinos to roll in, then destroy one or survive the encounter; heavy weapons and distance help.

Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach, stay out of camera and guard sightlines, grab the goods and leave clean. If you are spotted, leave and try again — the attempt only counts when it stays undetected.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: one detection voids the attempt. Scout the store first and go in quiet.

guides.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vaults open up as the story progresses; bring a fast getaway car and a planned route for each one.
Rob an Armored Truck and escape — stop a truck, grab the cash, and lose the cops. Ram it or block the road to force it to stop, take the money, then break line of sight until the wanted level clears.
Explore all of Leonida — visit all 52 named areas. The map fills in as you travel; drive and fly the edges of the state to catch the last areas, including the islands and the far north.
Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — hit one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are marked on the map once discovered; clear one per gang and the trophy pops.
Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — buy a drink at a beach bar on Ocean Beach and take in the view. It is a quiet moment, not a mission: sit down with the drink and let the scene play.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: nothing points you to this bar — stop at Ocean Beach between missions and order a drink.

guides.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive through a showroom's glass front and out the other side. Any showroom works; take a fast car, line up the exit, and go through.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: a stunt you have to attempt on purpose — no mission sends you through a showroom.

guides.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and finish it. The alley is marked on the map once discovered; complete all frames.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: it must be the Kolt & Associates alley specifically, and the game must be played to the end.

guides.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a story moment with your partner that draws a crowd. It comes from a specific story beat, so keep playing the story and it will find you.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: it is tied to one story moment — play the story beats as they come and do not rush past the scene.

guides.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — the game tracks 500 choice moments. Keep making dialogue and story choices as you play; the count accumulates across the whole playthrough, so it comes naturally by the end.
Second time's the charm — fail something, then succeed on the second try. Retry a failed activity or mission and complete it on the second attempt; the trophy pops when the retry succeeds.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: it only counts on the second attempt — if you fail twice, the chain resets, so retry once and finish it.

guides.guide: What the hell just happened? — witness one of Leonida's strange events. Strange encounters spawn in the world, often at night or in odd places; explore unusual map markers and stay until the event plays out.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: strange events are rare and unmarked — explore at night and investigate anything odd.

guides.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian and swing as you pass; the trophy pops on the knockdown.
guides.missableNote: Easy to miss: it must be a melee attack from a moving vehicle — drive slowly and time the swing.

guides.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies; sell them to your laundering contacts from the contacts menu and the total adds up across sales.
Spend $100,000 across all shops — buy clothes, weapons, cars and food until the total hits $100,000. The pause menu tracks total spend; big purchases like cars move it fastest.
Purchase all garage properties — buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. They appear on the real-estate map once you have the cash; buy each one and the trophy pops after the eighth.
Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — open the Scooter Bros app and register 10 vehicles you own or find. Any 10 distinct vehicles count; register each one as you come across it.
